author: KadirGarib
body:
Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) - Acharige
The reason you were temp-banned/banned - Flying?
Why you should be unbanned from the server. - I don't fly-hack, it has to be a false ban/misunderstanding. In my own defense, for the time I've played on the server, I have never been accounted for hacking, but combat logging, and not 'being nice', I've been given an infraction for, and I can't deny that. In the incident of me being banned, I was in the map "Alpha Complex", everyone was frozen (same with chat), I was able to do glide (not fly). Didn't think it looked like that for others. I'd also like to answer the questions below:

  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? False/misunderstanding, I do not hack. But I do lag often on the server.
  • Do i have any evidence to show the staff if was false? Not sure how I can prove it to you.
  • Have i waited long enough to be un-banned? Considering it as a false ban, I've waited less than a day. I'd like to prove my point that I don't hack.
  • Have i been caught ban evading? Never.
  • Have i appealed a ban before? Nope, first time.
I kindly ask to be pardoned from my infraction.

title: Appeal...

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Well. 

Glide is where you are already in the air hence "gliding" downwards. No one can glide upwards.

We have Video evidence that shows you flying "upwards" which would suggest flying. "not gliding because of lag.

even console picked you up during this video.

So in the end this appeal is denied. And while take a few months to be appealed.
